preconditions.name: spread_dv_measurable
preconditions.description: POSITIVE CONTROL for the statistic C1/C2 route on. The REAL trained head is fed synthetic, genuinely differentiated candidate summaries and the SAME cross-candidate range is read off it. A flat zero contrast on real candidates has two causes -- the propagated bias is candidate-uniform (the finding), or nothing could have registered a spread at all (head last layer still at its zero init, dead measurement path). Without this control they are indistinguishable and a starved run self-routes a falsification. Worst cell, not the mean, because `met` quantifies over cells.

preconditions.name: raw_stage_replica_matches_substrate
preconditions.description: The load-bearing DV is read at the RAW PRE-TANH stage, which the driver recomputes from the substrate's own head rather than by editing the module under validation. This gate confirms the replica IS that path: it compares the replica against the substrate's real output inverted through the exact analytic inverse raw = bias_scale*atanh(bias/bias_scale). If the module's output stage ever changes, the replica cannot silently diverge -- the run self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of reporting a statistic from a path the substrate no longer takes. Worst cell, since `met` quantifies over cells.
preconditions.control: substrate's own compute_bias output, analytically inverted through atanh

preconditions.name: uniform_control_reads_as_uniform
preconditions.description: NEGATIVE CONTROL for C1's statistic. Candidate summaries held CONSTANT across candidates -- the provably zero-information input, the exact shape the legacy ws[0,0,:] read produced -- are pushed through the real trained head at a live tick and the SAME discrimination index is read off. It must fall BELOW C1's own bar. WHAT IT DOES AND DOES NOT SHOW, stated plainly rather than overclaimed: given the consumer's centering step a candidate-constant input is annihilated to zero, so this control reads exactly 0 BY CONSTRUCTION, and the gate is a construction check -- it fires only if the index is mis-implemented (wrong axis, a fallback returning a non-zero constant, or centering removed from the substrate), not if the propagated bias merely happens to be uniform. It therefore does NOT on its own separate the raw stage from the post-tanh one, since both read 0 here; the side-by-side raw-vs-post-tanh numbers recorded under C5 are what do that. Worst (maximum) cell.
preconditions.control: candidate-constant summaries through the real trained head

preconditions.name: control_probes_sampled
preconditions.description: worst-cell count of in-loop control-probe reads (positive and negative) clears the floor -- both controls now run INSIDE the measurement loop at live-rule_state ticks, so a cell with none of them has no control at all.

preconditions.name: bias_head_optimizer_live_on_arm
preconditions.description: LIVENESS, not trainedness (822f, autopsy (c)): the real distance ||W_p1 - W_init||_F SUMMED over every head parameter tensor (red-team F6: the first layer moves ~8x more than the last and is what changes ReLU masks), worst ARM_ON cell, against HEAD_PARAM_DISTANCE_FLOOR. Replaces 822e's signed difference-of-norms gate, which failed exactly the cells that trained inward. Scoped to the TREATMENT arm: the pool-control arm holds no veto. This certifies the optimizer stepped and nothing more -- the trained-vs-init question is C1'. Per-tensor distances are recorded in per_seed_rows[].head_param_distance_init_to_p1.
preconditions.control: init tensors captured before the first optimizer step

preconditions.name: flip_resolution_sufficient
preconditions.description: C2's floor is a fraction of pooled ticks, and with n ticks the smallest non-zero fraction expressible is 1/n -- so a 0.02 bar is unresolvable below 50 ticks regardless of how the substrate behaves. This gates the SCHEDULE, not the DV's range, which is why it sits beside the dv_headroom entries rather than inside C2's. Floor is 4x the bare resolution requirement.

C1's bar on the raw-stage discrimination index must lie inside what that index can reach on this head. Achievable is measured from the IN-LOOP POSITIVE CONTROL (synthetic genuinely-differentiated summaries, real K, real row norm, real trained head, live rule_state), not from this run's own treatment cells. The index also has an ANALYTIC ceiling of K (the candidate count, 32 here) and an analytic null of 0 (candidate-uniform), so both ends of its range are known. WHAT THIS ENTRY CAN AND CANNOT CERTIFY: because the index is scale-free, randn-differentiated summaries through any head with a live rule pathway read close to the iid reference (~5.15 median at K=32), so in practice this entry certifies that the measurement path is LIVE and the bar is reachable -- it is not a sensitive test and is expected to pass. The bar's two-sidedness rests on the MEASURED cell values (0.59-4.11 at probe scale), not on this entry.
preconditions.name: dv_headroom_raw_discrimination_index
preconditions.headroom_reason: DV headroom met: prop_ratio_raw_median can reach 5.27776 (max_abs over 10 finite value(s)), against a required 2 (criterion threshold 1 x margin 2).

preconditions.description: C2's DV is a PROPORTION, so its achievable range is ARITHMETIC ([0,1]) rather than sampled -- dv_achievable's analytic route. Its null is 0 EXACTLY: a candidate-uniform raw shift through a monotone squash cannot change an argmax. The binding feasibility constraint on a 0.02 floor is RESOLUTION (1/n with n pooled ticks), which is gated separately as flip_resolution_sufficient. The synthetic positive control is deliberately NOT the achievable measurement here -- see FLIP_TICKS_FLOOR's comment for the geometry mismatch that makes it a harder test than the measurement itself.
preconditions.control: arithmetic bound of a proportion, plus a separate resolution gate
preconditions.name: dv_headroom_argmax_flip_fraction
preconditions.headroom_reason: DV headroom met: pooled_rule_flip_frac can reach 1 (analytic ceiling supplied by the caller, not measured from a sample), against a required 0.04 (criterion threshold 0.02 x margin 2).

preconditions.description: C4 reads a BETWEEN-ARM DIFFERENCE, so its achievable measurement is the realised seed-to-seed RANGE of the index within the CONTROL ARM ONLY (dv_achievable's documented 'range' case). Deliberately not the across-ALL-cells range: that is the treatment effect, so a large effect would certify its own headroom and a genuine SD-078 null would read as an unreachable DV. A margin larger than the index's control-arm spread could not be resolved from seed noise.

criteria.name: C1prime_trained_minus_init_discrimination_index_on_arm
criteria.detail: 822f's LOAD-BEARING SD-082 criterion (autopsy (a)). At every live P2 tick the raw pre-tanh discrimination index is read through the TRAINED head and through the deep-copied INIT head on the SAME summaries and the SAME live rule_state; D = trained - init, paired per tick, per-cell median. ARM_ON: mean D 0.0627 (sd 0.2005; init-median sd 0.535) against requirement max(0.5, sd_D, sd_init) = 0.5; seeds with D > 0: 2/5 (required 4). Mirrored weakens clause: c1prime_negative=False. ARM_OFF (reported, never gating): mean D -0.1967, positive 3/5. An absolute index a random-init head clears 99 percent of the time is NOT a criterion; this is.

criteria.name: C1_raw_discrimination_index_on_arm
criteria.detail: ABSOLUTE floor 1.0 on the RAW pre-tanh discrimination index (cross-candidate range / mean-abs of bias_raw(rule_state)-bias_raw(0)), on the arm in the intended operating regime: ARM_ON 4/5 seeds clear, majority required 3. ABSOLUTE, not a contrast: SD-082's question is a property of the propagated bias. The index is SCALE-FREE by construction, so it measures spread-per-magnitude and NOT magnitude -- C2 is the functional-consequence backstop, and C3 carries the magnitude reading. Reference: for K independent zero-mean values the index concentrates at ~5.15 (K=32), so a cell below that has a common-mode component.

criteria.name: C1b_same_floor_on_pool_control_arm
criteria.detail: The IDENTICAL floor 1.0, evaluated on ARM_OFF: 3/5 seeds clear. Applied and reported -- which is the negative-control application 822d omitted -- but NOT gating, and that is deliberate. BOTH arms carry SD-082's own fix, so ARM_OFF clearing is CONFIRMATORY rather than contaminating, and ARM_OFF failing is a fact about the rule-pool arm. Making it a conjunct would hand SD-078's knob a veto over SD-082's direction -- the same misattribution this letter exists to remove, in mirror image.

criteria.name: C2_argmax_flip_pooled
criteria.detail: POOLED argmax-flip fraction over all cells of both arms: 260/1701 = 0.1529 against floor 0.02. Independent of C1: an order-preserving propagated bias has a large index and flips nothing. Null is 0 exactly. Pooled rather than worst-cell because the per-cell rates rest on single-digit flip counts -- piloted, found under-powered at cell granularity.

criteria.name: C4_sd078_ratio_contrast
criteria.detail: ARM_ON minus ARM_OFF on the SAME index, per seed: 2/5 seeds clear margin 0.25 (required 4), mean contrast 0.06943. THIS CRITERION BELONGS TO SD-078 ALONE -- the arm axis is crf_cue_centering, SD-078's rule-pool knob, while SD-082's own fix is ON in BOTH arms. It is load-bearing for SD-078's direction and DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from the overall PASS conjunction, which is SD-082's question. Two-sided: 2 seeds clear the mirrored negative margin (c4_negative=False). Its dv_headroom entry is measured on the CONTROL ARM's seed spread only and gates SD-078's direction alone -- never run-level readiness, which would let an SD-078 null void an SD-082 result.

criteria.name: C3_legacy_magnitude_floor_applied_to_both_arms
criteria.detail: 822d's ON-only floor 0.001: ON=0.00119685 cleared=True, OFF=0.00155456 cleared=True. DIAGNOSTIC, gates nothing. passed=False here means the floor cannot discriminate -- which is exactly what 822d's own manifest showed and never applied to its negative control.

criteria.name: C5_post_tanh_spread_diagnostic
criteria.detail: The POST-TANH cross-candidate spread -- the statistic the first 822e draft made load-bearing -- is measured and recorded here but gates NOTHING. tanh is monotone but not affine, so a PERFECTLY UNIFORM raw shift emerges as a non-uniform post-tanh delta (a uniform +0.01 at base raws 0.0 and 0.05 gives 9.9668e-3 and 7.4932e-3, a manufactured spread of 2.4736e-3), which is the candidate-uniform state this DV exists to exclude. Kept visible so the two stages can be compared in the manifest rather than argued about later.

interpretation.combination_rule_822f: overall PASS = readiness AND C1' (trained-minus-init discrimination index, ARM_ON, noise-aware against both the D spread and the in-run init-head spread, plus a 4/5 paired sign clause). dir_082 = supports | weakens (mirrored clause) | inconclusive, from C1' ONLY. C1 (absolute index) and C2 (pooled flips) are REPORTED with their init-head counterparts and gate nothing. dir_078 = C4 through the detectability clause: supports/weakens need the seed clause AND |t_like| >= SD078_T_DETECT; otherwise inconclusive; unknown when C4's control-arm headroom fails. Readiness now includes the ARM_ON-scoped liveness distance gate and dv_headroom_trained_minus_init_index; 822e's hr_c1/hr_c2 are recorded entries only. The 822e combination_rule text below is retained for provenance and is SUPERSEDED by this paragraph.
interpretation.combination_rule: overall PASS = readiness AND C1 AND C2. Both load-bearing SD-082 criteria are ABSOLUTE rather than contrasts, because SD-082's question -- is the propagated bias candidate-DISCRIMINATING or candidate-UNIFORM -- is an absolute property, and because both arms carry SD-082's own fix (candidate_summary_source='proposer_post_action' is passed unconditionally, so no ON/OFF contrast can attribute to it). C1 gates on ARM_ON, the intended operating regime; the IDENTICAL floor is evaluated on ARM_OFF and reported as C1b, applied but not gating -- see C1b's detail for why a conjunction over both arms would be a second misattribution rather than conservatism. C1 and C2 are independent of each other: an order-preserving bias clears C1 and fails C2. C1 is SCALE-FREE, so 'confirmed' means the propagated bias has cross-candidate STRUCTURE, not that it is large; C2 (a flip of the real committed selection) is what makes the structure functionally consequential, and C3 carries the magnitude reading alongside. A magnitude gate is deliberately NOT re-added -- the ratified autopsy withdrew exactly that DV as unable to separate uniform from discriminating. C4 is load-bearing for SD-078's direction ONLY: it is out of this conjunction AND out of run-level readiness, so neither an SD-078 null nor an unreachable C4 bar can void an SD-082 result. C1b, C3 and C5 gate nothing. Every failure branch that is not a positive finding routes to inconclusive, never to a claim direction.

SD-082.note: SD-082's direction is a function of C1, C2 and the uniform-verdict floor ONLY. No between-arm contrast quantity enters it. That is structural, not a caveat: the arm axis (crf_cue_centering) is SD-078's rule-pool knob and SD-082's own fix is ON IN BOTH ARMS, so an ON-vs-OFF contrast cannot attribute to SD-082 under any reading -- which is 822d's withdrawn misattribution shape with the claim roles swapped. The DV is read at the RAW PRE-TANH stage because the consumer's tanh output stage manufactures apparent cross-candidate range out of a uniform raw shift.

SD-078.note: SD-078's direction is a function of C4 ONLY -- the between-arm contrast on the rule-pool axis, which is the one comparison this design can attribute to it. SD-078's own differentiation is additionally verified as a readiness precondition (on_pool_differentiated / off_pool_pinned / rule_state_diff), not as a DV. C4 does not enter the overall PASS conjunction. A later autopsy must NOT read a blanket verdict on this run as a direct test of SD-078: it is a co-tag, and its contrast is mediated entirely by SD-082's consumer.
